title: Book-level volatility estimator for the 10% target, walk-forward selection
mechanics: Sharpe-weighted sleeves (14), leverage = 0.10 / annualised estimate, cap 3, lagged one day
selection: weights fitted on 2010-06..2017-12, scored by book Sharpe 2018-22
judgement: chosen estimator with weights from 2010-22; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.102; adopt only if not R60 and higher
